services.long: Student visas and graduate visas such as subclass 485 and 476.

services.title: Partner & family visas

services.title: Appeals & refusals

services.title: Professional Year & courses

faq: Is A Class a registered migration agent?
Yes. Amandeep Kaur Sandhu is registered with MARN 2217996. You can check it on the official OMARA register.
Do you help with business visas?
Can you help after a visa refusal?
Yes. We help with refusals, cancellations, tribunal appeals and ministerial intervention.

aboutParas: A Class Immigration and Education Consultants is based at Level 1, 7/334 Hume Highway, Craigieburn, and has been registered as a business since 2022.
Registered migration agent Amandeep Kaur Sandhu (MARN 2217996) helps with student, graduate, skilled, regional, employer-sponsored, family and business visas, as well as appeals.
On the education side, the team helps with Professional Year programs, course choice, career counselling, scholarships and health insurance.
